/cuts/#0/text: The only forge in a little mountain village… No customers left, and it's about to shut its doors for good!
/cuts/#1/text: A few years back, there was always a kid pressed up against this window. "When I grow up, I'm gonna go adventuring with a sword like that!"
/cuts/#2/text: Now that kid's sixteen—and just burst through the door. "Boss! I'm gonna be an adventurer! But… I don't have a single decent sword!"
/cuts/#3/text: "I can't pay, but I'll go dig up the materials myself! Just make me the best sword ever!" For the first time in ages, I grabbed my dusty hammer like I meant it.
/cuts/#4/text: "Deal! I'll forge the swords—you bring the materials!" The fire roared back to life, and our forge's big comeback began!
